narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Fixed. Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Only 3 cases exposed it, ones with both a nonzero discount and tax.

Next: nothing.
